import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long sum = 0;
        if (n > 0) {
            long i = 0;
            do {
                long y = scanner.nextLong();
                sum += y;
                ++i;
            } while (i < n);
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
